metadata.technology_specification: Touchscreen smartphone with OLED display and lithium-ion battery
metadata.technology_reasoning: Modern smartphones with OLED displays represent over 60% of premium and mid-range devices as of 2024, having become the industry standard due to superior contrast, power efficiency, and thin form factors.

Display Module (OLED).name: Glass
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Provides structural support and optical clarity in displays, universally used as the substrate for OLED displays with high confidence.

Display Module (OLED).name: Indium
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Key component of ITO transparent conductive films in OLEDs, industry standard material with few alternatives currently.

Display Module (OLED).name: Silver
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Common cathode electrode material but alternatives like aluminum exist; hence lower confidence.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Lithium
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Primary energy storage element in lithium-ion chemistry, absolutely essential for battery function with no viable alternatives at commercial scale.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Cobalt
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Cathode material providing high energy density, industry standard in NMC chemistry though LFP alternatives are emerging.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Nickel
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Cathode material enabling high energy density, commonly used in NMC and NCA chemistries but ratio varies by design.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Copper
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Essential electrical conductor for current collectors and internal wiring, universal across all battery designs.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Aluminum
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Casing material and cathode current collector, industry standard though some designs use steel casings.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Graphite
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Anode material critical for lithium intercalation, universal in commercial lithium-ion batteries.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Copper
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Primary electrical conductor for circuit traces on PCBs, universally essential.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Tin
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Common surface finish material for solder pads and components, industry standard solder alloy component.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Gold
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Used for high reliability contacts and selective plating, common but some alternatives exist.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Fiberglass
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Key structural reinforcement material in PCB laminates, industry standard with few substitutes.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Epoxy resins
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Primary polymer matrix for PCB substrates, critical for board integrity and insulation.

Camera Module.name: Glass
Camera Module.reasoning: Lens and sensor cover material providing optical clarity, the industry standard with few substitutes.

Camera Module.name: Silicon
Camera Module.reasoning: Semiconductor material for image sensors, absolutely essential and standard.

Camera Module.name: Copper
Camera Module.reasoning: Electrical conductor for sensor wiring and connectors, common with few alternatives.

Camera Module.name: Aluminum
Camera Module.reasoning: Used for housing and heat dissipation, common but some plastics or magnesium alternatives exist.

Camera Module.name: Indium
Camera Module.reasoning: Used in transparent conductive coatings for sensors, commonly used but alternatives like ITO formulations exist.

Chassis/Frame.name: Aluminum
Chassis/Frame.reasoning: Widely used lightweight metal for smartphone frames due to strength and corrosion resistance, industry standard.

Chassis/Frame.name: Stainless steel
Chassis/Frame.reasoning: High strength and corrosion resistant material used in premium smartphone frames, standard alternative to aluminum.

Speakers.name: Copper
Speakers.reasoning: Essential conductor for voice coil windings, universally used.

Speakers.name: Neodymium
Speakers.reasoning: Common rare earth magnet material for speaker magnets, industry standard.

Speakers.name: Aluminum
Speakers.reasoning: Used for diaphragms and structural components, alternatives exist but common choice.

Vibration Motor.name: Copper
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Primary conductor for coil windings generating magnetic fields, essential for operation.

Vibration Motor.name: Neodymium
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Rare earth magnet material for magnetic actuation, very commonly used though some motors use other magnets.

Vibration Motor.name: Steel Ingots
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Structural shell and shaft material, commonly used steel grade with some alternatives.
